card.name: Ad in "Adverse Reactions" cross-references
card.fires_on: The word piece "Ad" that begins "Adverse Reactions" inside bracketed cross-references such as [see Adverse Reactions (6.1)], usually after reports of skin or allergic reactions.

modes.label: After "see"
modes.description: "Ad" directly follows "[see" in a section pointer to Adverse Reactions.
modes.example: have been reported in patients receiving meropenem for injection [see<< Ad>>verse Reactions (6.2)]

modes.label: After "and" or comma
modes.description: "Ad" follows a Warnings and Precautions pointer joined by "and" or a comma.
modes.example: Serious skin reactions have occurred [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) and<< Ad>>verse Reactions (6.2)

card.writes: It adds little beyond finishing the word "Adverse"; the promoted and suppressed tokens show no clear link to it.
card.plain: It fires on the start of "Adverse Reactions" when a label points the reader to that section.
